name: Birder Linnet

intro.text: Peregrines nest on the cliffs at Beachy Head. Fastest animal on the planet, in a dive. I'll settle for fastest to a fight.

win: Outflown. I'll put it in my notebook as a 'difficult sighting'.
after: A peregrine's stoop can top 180 miles an hour. Mine tops out at a brisk walk to the café.
